hazards.label: Child emerges between parked cars
hazards.clue: Movement becomes visible at the gap before the child enters your path.
hazards.response: Ease off early and stop with space before the child. Do not assume the pavement is clear behind parked vehicles.

hazards.label: Pedestrian emerges from behind a delivery van
hazards.clue: The pedestrian becomes visible at the front of the van and continues towards the carriageway.
hazards.response: Slow down and be ready to stop; the van restricts your view of the pavement.

hazards.label: Cyclist continues across the intended left turn
hazards.clue: As the junction approaches, the cyclist continues ahead into the area you would cross to turn left.
hazards.response: Hold back behind the cyclist. Do not turn across their path.

hazards.label: Lorry starts moving into your lane
hazards.clue: An indicator is followed by lateral movement towards your lane.
hazards.response: Ease off to create a safe gap. Check mirrors before any change of position.

hazards.label: The vehicle ahead brakes as traffic slows
hazards.clue: The brake lamps illuminate and your gap to the slowing vehicle begins to close.
hazards.response: Brake progressively and preserve extra stopping space on the wet surface.

hazards.label: Slow tractor emerges onto the road
hazards.clue: A tractor appears at a field entrance and starts to occupy your path.
hazards.response: Reduce speed and wait for adequate visibility and space; do not attempt a blind overtake.

hazards.label: Bus indicates and starts moving from its stop
hazards.clue: The right indicator flashes as the bus moves away from the kerb.
hazards.response: Allow room for the bus to rejoin when safe. Keep watching for pedestrians.

hazards.label: Works vehicle reverses towards the open lane
hazards.clue: Reversing lights and movement show the works vehicle approaching your path.
hazards.response: Slow down and stop short of the work area. Leave space for the vehicle to manoeuvre.

hazards.label: Pedestrian approaches and enters the crossing
hazards.clue: A person turns towards the zebra crossing and moves to cross.
hazards.response: Be ready to give way to people waiting and give way once they are on the crossing.

hazards.label: An approaching emergency vehicle needs more space
hazards.clue: Blue lights approach and the emergency vehicle moves around an obstruction.
hazards.response: Create space calmly if safe, without mounting the pavement or breaching a red light.

hazards.label: A parked vehicle door opens towards your path
hazards.clue: The road-facing door begins to swing out from a parked vehicle.
hazards.response: Slow or stop rather than swerving into oncoming traffic. Leave a door-width gap where possible.

title: Horse rider at a field entrance

hazards.label: Horse and rider emerge ahead
hazards.clue: The horse and rider become visible at a hedge gap and move towards the road.
hazards.response: Slow right down, allow generous space, and avoid sudden noise or movement.

hazards.label: Child approaches the crossing beside an adult
hazards.clue: The child changes direction towards the crossing and the adult follows.
hazards.response: Approach ready to stop. Expect children to act unpredictably.

title: Residential double hazard
setting: Two separate events on a residential route

hazards.label: Parked vehicle pulls out
hazards.clue: A parked vehicle indicates and moves away from the kerb.
hazards.response: Ease off and allow space for the vehicle to join.

hazards.label: Pedestrian emerges further along the road
hazards.clue: After the first situation has cleared, a different pedestrian moves out from behind another parked vehicle.
hazards.response: Continue scanning after the first hazard; slow and stop for the pedestrian.
